subject: STABLE: TEGU_BREAK_DETAIL (per-pipeline split attribution); gates as before; c6l analysis; starting pass merging
body: compositor_submit.inc: TEGU_BREAK_DETAIL logged once per (reason, pipeline) for mrt/msaa/memfetch/owntex: fs name, rt count, main rt, active mask, true_mrt, fetch mode, input attachment indexes, tile flag, target, load, binding kinds. Gates: run_host_tests 58 PASS (known probe step), render harness, CA PF0/PF1 PASS; integration shows the known CA stride check + candidate provenance (others' uncommitted air_bridge.rs). c6l ui350 baseline (2700 cmds): every pass has 2 colour attachments (att=0/19702/0), attachment loads load 9820 / clear 29584; in-pass job splits = memfetch 11072 + mrt 11213 (+spans 1110, clear 663, maxdraw 122) = same_enc 24177; target 16855 ~= new_enc 17041 (pass boundaries). Pipelines (64 captured): 55 write rt0 only, 8 write rt1 only, none both -> 'mrt' jobs come from path pipelines reconciled to true MRT or from captures beyond the 64 logged; TEGU_BREAK_DETAIL will name them. Memfetch with TF1 = fetch reads an attachment other than the draw's rt (tile path requires input attachment == rt) or a true-MRT pipeline - also named by the detail line. Kernel: run_us 861, tot 916 per job but frontend exec 29 ms/cmd for 16.7 jobs = 1.74 ms/job: ~0.8 ms/job (13 ms/cmd) is CPU outside the kernel (bridge build/submit/frontend) - a target after pass merging. run_us estimate per full-screen job ~1.2 ms @350 -> 0.64-0.92 ms @654, 0.47-0.84 ms @886 (range = compute-bound vs half bandwidth-bound); small jobs ~0.23 ms -> 0.12-0.23 ms. Now reading the sibling pass-merge/AFBC docs for the <=2 full-screen jobs/frame target.
